template.name: USRealmAddressADUSFIELDED
template.desc: Reusable address template, for use in US Realm CDA Header.

element.name: cda:addr

attribute.name: use
attribute.desc: SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] @use, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet PostalAddressUse urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.1.11.10637 STATIC 2005-05-01 (CONF:81-7290).

element.constraint: *SHALL NOT* have mixed content except for white space

element.name: cda:country
element.desc: SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] country, which SHALL be selected from ValueSet Country urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.3.88.12.80.63 DYNAMIC (CONF:81-7295).

element.name: cda:state
element.desc: SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] state (ValueSet: StateValueSet urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.3.88.12.80.1 DYNAMIC) (CONF:81-7293).

span.style: text-indent: -24px; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: "Times New Roman";

desc.span: If the country is US, the state element is required but
have @nullFlavor if the state is unknown. If country is not specified, it's assumed to be US. If country is something other than US, the state

element.constraint: State is required if the country is US. If country is not specified, it's assumed to be US. If country is something other than US, the state MAY be present but MAY be bound to different vocabularies (CONF:81-10024).

If the country is US, the state element is required but SHOULD have @nullFlavor if the state is unknown. If country is not specified, it's assumed to be US. If country is something other than US, the state MAY be present but MAY be bound to different vocabularies (CONF:81-10024).

assert.test: @nullFlavor or (cda:country='US' and cda:state) or (cda:country!='US') or (not(cda:country) and cda:state)

element.assert: State is required if the country is US. If country is not specified, it's assumed to be US. If country is something other than US, the state MAY be present but MAY be bound to different vocabularies.

element.name: cda:postalCode
element.desc: SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] postalCode, which SHOULD be selected from ValueSet PostalCode urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.3.88.12.80.2 DYNAMIC (CONF:81-7294).
element.constraint: If the country is US, the postalCode element is required but SHOULD have @nullFlavor if the postalCode is unknown. If country is not specified, it's assumed to be US. If country is something other than US, the postalCode MAY be present but MAY be bound to different vocabularies (CONF:81-10025).

assert.test: @nullFlavor or (cda:country='US' and cda:postalCode) or (cda:country!='US') or (not(cda:country) and cda:postalCode)

element.assert: If the country is US, the postalCode element is required but SHOULD have @nullFlavor if the postalCode is unknown. If country is not specified, it's assumed to be US.
